$comment: Configuration for medienreaktor/figma-tools, run from a project that installs it with --base-path pointing at this package. `figma-download` refreshes figma-variables.json and figma-text-styles.json from the Neos Studio design file and needs FIGMA_MCP_TOKEN; `figma-import` turns them into CSS and needs no credentials.
$comment-rootFontSize: Studio renders at the browser default of 16px. Figma holds the rendered pixel values; every length comes out in rem against this root.

output.$comment: No public copy: Studio and its plugins load the Tailwind build, never a plain :root file. indent is 2 to match .editorconfig.

$comment-baseVariant: null on purpose: no leaf is named "default"; the semantic names are shadcn's and stay whole.

routes.$comment: Colours land directly in --color-*: the primitives keep Tailwind's palette names (--color-neutral-50), the theme tokens are shadcn's vocabulary (--color-muted-foreground), so neither the shell nor shadcn components need renaming. Radius replaces Tailwind's --radius-sm/md/lg/xl with Studio's sharper scale.

typography.$comment-sizeStrategy: styles.css switches Tailwind's font-size scale off, so a size never names a step (24px would otherwise become text-2xl).
typography.$comment: Families map onto the --font-* tokens styles.css declares: Noto Sans is --font-sans, the code font is Tailwind's mono stack (Figma uses JetBrains Mono to draw it), and the icon styles describe Font Awesome glyphs, which Studio declares as --font-icon. 'Solid' names Font Awesome's variant, not a weight, and correctly produces no font-* class.
